written.headline: Young victims seek legal accountability against xAI over Grok deepfakes
written.summary: Young victims whose photos were sexualized using Grok are seeking to hold xAI legally accountable for allowing users to generate such images. The legal effort involves victims whose childhood photos were processed by users into sexualized images.

written.headline: Agile Robots raises $500M led by SoftBank at $8.5B valuation
written.summary: Munich-based Agile Robots raised $500 million in a funding round led by SoftBank Group Corp. at an $8.5 billion valuation. The German robotics maker develops humanoids, mobile robots, robotic arms, and control software.

written.headline: Chinese AI firms rush to secure overseas Nvidia compute capacity amid US curb fears
written.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence companies are attempting to rent Nvidia-powered computing capacity at data centers outside China. The rush is driven by concerns that a controversy involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang could prompt Washington to tighten restrictions on remote access to advanced processors.

written.headline: Congress prepares subpoena for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over spy affair
written.summary: House Republicans are preparing a subpoena for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to answer questions regarding his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Lawmakers have set deadlines for Huang to respond to requests for a closed-door briefing.

written.headline: Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue after July 2025 blocklist
written.summary: Nvidia stopped reporting its Singapore revenue after the quarter ending in July 2025, when Singapore accounted for 22% of its revenue. The reporting halt followed Nvidia's decision to place Megaspeed on a blocklist.
